messages:
Ava: quick a11y sweep from this morning on the side details panel — found a few small but important nits. putting them here so we can triage. :eyes:
Sam: thanks — short list works. what did you run?
Ava: ran VoiceOver + NVDA on mac/chrome. also a quick color check with the contrast bot. highlights:
- muted metadata (e.g., ‘last updated’) is ~2.8:1 on light theme — fails AA for normal text.
- chip/tag elements (model tags) lose visible focus when using keyboard: outline is missing on the compressed variant.
- the details flyout traps tab on last interactive element instead of cycling back — users hit a dead end.
- decorative SVGs in the tag button are getting read by screen readers in Safari because they lack aria-hidden.
- a live region used for save-toasts is announcing duplicate messages when a batch save fires quickly.
Sam: can you paste repro steps? I can try to reproduce locally.
Ava: repro: open model -> click details (right rail) -> tab through chips (use keyboard only). on mac: VoiceOver + Safari, on windows: NVDA + Chrome. contrast-bot gave these specific color pairs: token-muted (#9aa0a6 on #ffffff) = 2.8:1.
contrast-bot: auto-check: token-muted (#9aa0a6 / #ffffff) -> 2.83:1 (fail AA). chip-focus (outline current) -> not found. live-region element duplicates when innerText updates without role="status" toggling.
Nadia: thanks for details. main priorities: 1) restore visible focus for chip compressed variant, 2) fix color token or bump font weight, 3) ensure decorative svgs have aria-hidden="true", 4) dedupe live-region announcements.
Liam: trivial fixes? I can take the focus ring + svg aria-hidden in one small PR. contrast change might need design token decision.
Ava: yes Liam that'd be great. for the focus ring please match existing token: outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring) and keep offset 2px so it doesn't overlap rounded chip.
Sam: about the tab trap — are we missing tabindex on the close X? I can check the flyout focus trap logic in the component.
Nadia: for toasts use role="status" and update innerText only after clearing previous text (or toggle aria-live politely). pattern we've used in other places: set innerText = '' then setTimeout(()=> innerText = msg, 10). avoids duplicate announce.
Ava: for contrast I'd prefer to keep tokens consistent. options: bump muted token to #757b80 (meets 4.5:1) or use semibold on metadata (600). design preference?
Nadia: prefer color token update rather than changing weight for consistency across components. keep typographic rhythm stable.
Liam: I'll prototype both in the branch so we can do quick A/B — token change + semibold fallback in CSS var.
Sam: tagging for QA: once PR is up, can we include quick steps: VoiceOver + NVDA checks, keyboard only nav, color contrast report screenshot, and a short note about toast dedupe?
Ava: yup I'll add acceptance criteria. quick checklist to include in PR description:
- keyboard: tab through chips, visible focus on compressed + regular variants
- no tab trap in details flyout (tab cycles or focuses close button then returns)
- SVGs inside tag buttons have aria-hidden="true" and not read by SR
- contrast report screenshot showing token change passing 4.5:1
- toast announcements not duplicated in quick batch save
Liam: starting branch now. will ping when draft PR ready. :thumbsup:
Ava: awesome — thanks. tagging Nadia for final review before merge. :pray:
Nadia: will review accessibility bits. small nit: change button label from "Copy" to "Copy model ID" where ambiguous — avoids generic button label being announced out of context.
Ava: good call, will add copy tweak to the PR.
Liam: draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1378 (wip) — includes focus ring + aria-hidden + token suggestion in CSS vars. still needs toast fix + tests.
Sam: re-tested locally — focus ring visible, chip keyboard nav works, NVDA reads tags once. quick contrast screenshot attached in PR.
Ava: moving to review state. QA checklist attached in PR description. Thanks team! :tada:
